label: Radiation alert

alert.text: Radiation alert: elevated dose rate. Early warning of a solar particle event; shelter early (ALARA).

notes: Peak window of the September 2017 event in hazards.json models.sep_2017_profile: background 240 uGy/day (10 uGy/h) and peak 718 uGy/day (29.92 uGy/h), RAD B detector in Gale crater, not Jezero. The 12-minute duration is a SIM compression for one EVA; the accumulated dose uses the real rates: the environment runner (src/sim/environmentRunner.js) sums environment.doseRateUgyH into environment.doseUgy over mission time, so the event sets only the rate. Shelter is the habitat, the only full-protection shelter in public/data/shelters.json.
